title: Charming Donelson Home-the "Giraffe House"
description:
Are you looking for a Nashville vacation, but don't want to be in the middle of downtown, then this house is for you! Home is 6 miles from Opryland Hotel/Convention Cntr.  With an excellent selection of restaurants & groceries nearby, it is the perfect space for your family or group of friends.  Property is  2 miles from BNA and 7 miles from Nashville’s top sites.    Pets allowed by request only!

The space
House: 3 bedrooms with 2 full baths.  Large backyard deck, with grill & firepit for those cool evenings.  It has a fantastic game room with Smart TV, darts, air hockey, hook-a-ring as well as many board games & playing cards.  It also boasts of a fully stocked kitchen with everything you will need, including a crockpot. Additional space just off primary suite allows for multiple people to get ready simultaneously.

Guest access
Access to entire home with exception to Owner's closet.

Other things to note
Pets are by request only! Please inquire in advance.  A fee of $100 per pet will be charged if permitted to stay.  Evidence of unauthorized pets will cause a $300 fee per pet to be charged.

Absolutely No Parties!!!   We love & respect our neighbors. 

No Smoking or Vaping.  If evidence is found, you will be charged $500 fee.

OUTSIDE:
In the backyard, there is an open-air, multi-level patio with table, umbrella and 6 chairs as well as 2 lounge chairs that can comfortably accommodate all guests. It has a grill and is a perfect area to relax, enjoy the firepit and end the day with a glass of wine and good conversation with your friends and family.

You will enjoy this home!
